used: data-quality-craft/applies-here.md 'The silent semantic change, and what actually catches one here': the meaning (the printed precision) of Sam's unit-price field changed on 2026-09-20 and every derived size moved with it. The external referent it names, Sam's own unit price, is here the number that is WRONG: the derived size IS that unit price divided into the line price, so the only independent referent left on the row is the NAME's stated weight, bound to volume by density.

grocery/derived-size-density-lib.ps1 header (the rule, the 0.75-1.65 g/mL band derived from measured grocery-liquid densities, the multipack and coarse-rounding abstentions): reused whole, not copied. It calls itself 'the cross-measure half of the Sazon rule' and until today only a watcher ran it.

memory:grocery-method-sams (read in full): Sam's is a unit-price feed normalised at ingest; linePrice and unitPrice are both captured and the capture has no size field of its own, so a derived size is lp/up by construction.

memory:no-hardcoded-bands (read in full): Brad's 2026-09-04 ruling is about per-run MACRO bands. The density band is a stated physical property of grocery liquids already named once in the lib; this change adds no constant and moves no threshold.

.claude/rules/ops-and-gates.md: fixture vocabulary (MUST FIRE / MUST NOT FIRE / CLEAN TWIN by assertion); a frozen fixture is never regenerated from the live tree; the at-the-bar rule applies to a NEW threshold and this adds none (the band's edges are the lib's, pinned in test-auditors u134).
.claude/rules/grocery.md: right prices in the wrong basis is the hardest defect to find later; the Sazon rule refuses, never guesses.

items.subject: Grocery: the live board failed a watcher (watchers intact)
evidence: test-auditors (pre-push leg, 07:56, tc-prepush-ta-43492-0cb3dc22.out): 766 pass, 1 FAIL, derived-size-density live arm: 2 unruled capture rows, both in out/sams/sams-deals-2026-09-21.json (df1d6429e, blob f5f72285).

Row 1: Member's Mark Pure Soybean Oil, 35 lbs. | $29.98 | sams_unit_price '3.6 c/fl oz' (cent glyph) | size 832.778 fl oz | qty_basis 'package; qty derived lp/up' | 29.98/0.036 = 832.778 | 35 lb = 15,876 g -> 0.645 g/mL.
Row 2 (the second row the alert did not name): Member's Mark Peanut Oil, 35 lbs. | $55.96 | '6.6 c/fl oz' | 847.879 fl oz | derived lp/up | 55.96/0.066 = 847.879 -> 0.633 g/mL. SAME cause as row 1.

Both products were flagged and RULED on 2026-08-30 at their dollar-form sizes (peanut 799.429 fl oz from $0.07/foz, soybean 799.6 fl oz from $39.98 at $0.05/foz). The rulings pin the SIZE and say retire_when 'the derived size changes'. Sam's cents notation (since 2026-09-20, taught to the builder in e5d0a00a1) re-derived both, and the soybean price also moved $39.98 -> $29.98, so the watcher fired exactly as designed.

Board: 0 occurrences of 'soybean' or 'Peanut Oil, 35' in comparison-2026-09-20.json (05:08, live) or comparison-2026-09-21.json (08:05, HELD by guards on band-censorship, queue 2026-09-21-da5011). peanut-oil|SamsClub is blocked by known-wrong (2026-08-30); soybean matches no commodity.

CLASS COUNT, today (sams-deals-2026-09-21, 1,032 rows): 147 carry a size derived from lp/up (14.2%); the capture has no size field, so the rest are name-stated. Of the 147 the name states: nothing 101, a count only 25, a volume 13, a weight only 8. The density rule can JUDGE 6 of 147 (weight on the label, volume in the size): 2 flagged (the rows above), 4 in band at 0.875-0.886 g/mL (Canola Salad Oil 35 lbs 0.875; Clear Frying Oil 35 lbs x2 0.886; Creamy Liquid Shortening 35lbs 0.886), each 3-4.5% under an edible oil's 0.91-0.93 against a rounding band of 0.76-0.88%, so Sam's per-fl-oz price is off on all 6 of the 6 weight-labelled jugs, by 30-44% on 2 and 3-4.5% on 4. The other 141 have no physical referent at all.

CLASS COUNT, previous full generation (sams-deals-2026-09-19, 2,802 rows): 322 derived (11.5%); judged 4, flagged 2 (the same two products at 799.6 and 799.429, ruled), in band 2 (frying oil at 571.143 fl oz from '$0.07/foz' = 0.940, inside that print's +/-7.1%). 2026-09-20 was an outage slice: 19 rows, 2 derived, 0 judgeable.

ROUNDING, every derived row: size_rounding_pct is stamped on 147 of 147 today (median 0.15%, p90 0.72%, max 12.5%; 8 over 1%, 2 over 5%) and 322 of 322 on 2026-09-19 (median 0.26%, p90 7.14%, max 50%). compare-deals recomputes it and applies it in the crown test (Get-RoundingBandTies, compare-deals.ps1:3091; Get-CellRoundingPct :3125). A derived row's per-unit price is Sam's printed unit price exactly, so the rounding error is carried as an error bar on every row, not only the ones the band catches.

items.root_cause: build-sams-deals' Build-Row decides a row's size by comparing the NAME's quantities with Sam's printed unit price in the same UNIT TOKEN (the Sazon rule). A name that states pounds against a price per fluid ounce is 'silent in the priced unit', so lp/up is taken as the size with nothing checking it, and every error in Sam's own unit price becomes a size error of the same factor. The one referent that CAN check it, density binding the label weight to the derived volume, lived only in a downstream watcher, so each occurrence was written first and ruled by hand afterwards (four rulings since 2026-08-30), and a ruling pins one size, so any movement in Sam's number or notation reopens it.

root_fix.what: apply the density rule AT INGEST: Build-Row runs derived-size-density-lib's Test-DerivedSizeDensity on every derived size and REFUSES a row the rule flags (a per-row reject 'DENSITY CONFLICT', the same answer the Sazon rule gives inside one unit). One copy of the rule: the builder dot-sources the same lib compare-deals and test-auditors do. Abstentions and out-of-scope rows keep their path. The watcher stays as the downstream check over every capture on disk.
root_fix.exact_change: build-sams-deals.ps1: dot-source derived-size-density-lib.ps1 beside pricing-math-lib; in Build-Row, after the package size is formed and before the shape tries, when $basis is 'derived lp/up' build a probe {item, size, qty_basis, sams_unit_price} and return err 'DENSITY CONFLICT: <the lib's Why> - Sam's <up> was computed against a volume this package cannot hold' on Status 'flag'. Self-test 8k: two MUST FIRE (today's real rows), one CLEAN TWIN (same jug at the unit price its weight implies, still derived and published), one MUST NOT FIRE (a pack-shaped ratio abstains, not refused). test-auditors.ps1 u134: the two cents-form rows frozen verbatim as MUST FIRE for the watcher; an additive correction on the frying-oil CLEAN TWIN's claim that 0.940 was 'right'.
